title: test: OpenPGP SELECT AID failure (0x6A82 file not found)
description: wp11_test_openpgp.c tests the success path for SELECT AID. No test injects a 0x6A82 (file not found) response to verify the library returns WP11_OPENPGP_ERR_SW or equivalent rather than proceeding as if the applet is present. This matters for tokens that do not implement the OpenPGP applet -- the library should fail cleanly, not silently operate on a different applet. Add a mock-response unit test.
